beats.say: Pull request {{facts.number}}, by {{facts.authorLogin}}: hide stalled queued sandbox sessions. {{facts.additions}} lines added across {{facts.changedFiles}} files, and it is merged.

The PR targets core sandbox session lists. Some tasks look like real sessions, but the author says they are apparently never-started sandboxes. The change uses metadata already fetched during discovery, not a new connection or history read.

claims.text: The PR hides apparently never-started sandbox tasks from core sandbox session lists using metadata already fetched during discovery.

evidence.body: Hide apparently never-started sandbox tasks from the core sandbox session lists using metadata already fetched during discovery.

claims.text: It does not connect to or wake sandboxes or read histories.

evidence.body: This does not connect to or wake sandboxes, read their histories

beats.say: The filter is narrow. It needs the exact title New remote session, a queued task, exactly one queued session, no ahp_resource_uri, matching created and updated timestamps, and at least one hour of age.

claims.text: The implementation requires the title New remote session, task state queued, exactly one session, session state queued, no AHP resource, matching timestamps, and a finite created time.

beats.say: Discovery caches the candidate creation time, reevaluates it on incremental scans, reports filtered task IDs as removals, and can restore the row when a later update says the session started.

claims.text: Cached candidates are reevaluated during incremental discovery, filtered task IDs are reported as removals, and later discovery can restore started sessions.

evidence.body: Cache the candidate creation time and reevaluate it on incremental scans even outside the update window, without additional detail requests.
Report filtered task IDs as explicit removals for incremental/partial reconciliation.
A later discovery update can restore a session that starts successfully.

claims.text: The tests cover cached incremental expiration and recovery.

evidence.anchor: reevaluates cached candidates outside the incremental window
restores a hidden task when discovery reports that its session started
